BIRLA INSTITUTE OF TECHNOLOGY, MESRA, RANCHI
(MID SEMESTER EXAMINATION SP2023)
CLASS:  BTECH   SEMESTER : IV
BRANCH: PIE   SESSION : SP2023

SUBJECT: PE216 FOUNDRY, FORMING & WELDING TECHNOLOGIES
TIME: 02 Hours   FULL MARKS: 25

INSTRUCTIONS:
1. The question paper contains 5 questions each of 5 marks and total 25 marks.
2. Attempt all questions.
3. The missing data, if any, may be assumed suitably.
4. Tables/Data handbook/Graph paper etc., if applicable, will be supplied to the candidates
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

   CO BL
Q.1(a) Enumerates  the merits and demerits of the casting processes over other methods  of
manufacturing.
[3] CO1 BL2
Q.1(b) For the product shown in Fig 1, what type of pattern will you select for sand casting?
Justify

Fig 1: A large cast wheel.
[2] CO1 BL5

Q.2(a) Design a pattern for the part shown in Fig 2 using the following allowances: Machining
allowance: 2 mm for the circular hole and 3 mm for all other dimensions, Shrinkage
allowance: 4% for the circular hole, and 3% for all other dimensions.

Fig 2: Cast component
[3] CO1 BL6
Q.2(b) ‘Metal in the riser should remain the molten condition for a longer time than in the
mould cavity’. Analyze & explain why and how this is achieved.
[2] CO1 BL4

Q.3(a) How can you tell whether cavities in a casting are due to porosity or to shrinkage? [2] CO1 BL5
Q.3(b) A riser in the shape of a sphere is to be designed for a sand-casting mould. The casting
is a rectangular plate, with length = 200 mm, width = 100 mm, and thickness = 18 mm.
If the total solidification time of the casting itself is known to be 3.5 min, design the
riser so that it will take 25% longer for the riser to solidify.
[3] CO1 BL6

Q.4(a) Compare and contrast investment casting and lost foam casting.  [3] CO2 BL4
Q.4(b) Differentiate between hot chamber die casting and cold chamber die casting. [2] CO2 BL4

Q.5(a) What  are  the  different  types  of  electrodes  used  in  arc  welding?  Cite  examples  of
processes in which they are used.
[3] CO3 BL2
Q.5(b) When will you use direct current reverse polarity (DCRP)? [2] CO3 BL4
